description: Presidential Secretariate - Essential Public Services Act No. 61 of 1979
categorisation: This gazette content involves the President using powers under the Essential Public Services Act (No. 61 of 1979) to declare postal services as an essential public service. This constitutes a regulatory action under existing legislation, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The content focuses on the application of a legal framework and regulatory authority.
